evidence.quote: Fees and expenses would be separately paid and subject to court approval; any amount not awarded would augment the class fund.
any reduction in the requested award would increase the class fund.
Hargrove offers the lowest aggregate demand with strong approval-oriented safeguards.
Prioritize Hargrove for a binding proposal and keep the other discussions open

summary: Plaintiff counsel raised fees in the first round, and fees were negotiated before class relief was settled. The terms expressly directed unawarded fees to the class, linking the fee award to recovery. Defense prioritized the counsel with the lowest aggregate demand and ultimately settled with that firm; the transcript does not show counsel sacrificing class relief for its own fees or misleading the court.
